title: Liability Package Schedule for Endorsement Premium on Monthly Draft Notices — Installment Payment Plans
content:
**Clause.** Under the company's own filed percentages for the **Installment Payment Plans**, a draft notice on the Cardinal Point Monthly EFT Plan or the Cardinal Point Monthly Card Autopay Plan billing an Owner Auto Policy term adds to its premium a percentage of the endorsement premium not yet billed (every additional premium transaction booked on the Owner Auto Policy term, less the premium the plan's installment invoices have billed beyond the scheduled installment premium once for each of them), set by the liability package of that Owner Auto Policy term:

- when the term carries the Cardinal Point Minimum Limits Liability package, 2.5 percent;
- when it carries the Cardinal Point 50/100/50 Liability package, 1.5 percent;
- when it carries any higher package — Cardinal Point 100/200/50, 100/300/50, 100/300/100 or 250/500/100 Liability — nothing.

**Schedule**

| Liability package of the Owner Auto Policy term | Percentage added |
|---|---|
| Cardinal Point Minimum Limits Liability | 2.5 |
| Cardinal Point 50/100/50 Liability | 1.5 |
| Cardinal Point 100/200/50 Liability and every higher package | none |

The package is read from the Owner Auto Policy term the plan bills.

*Hypothetical case.* A term on the Cardinal Point 50/100/50 Liability package with 180.00 of endorsement premium not yet billed: 1.5 percent of 180.00, which is 2.70.
